item.title: Probation — Procurement: PEAK Drop In Centers Program NAE with CASES
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
PEAK (Pathways to Excellence, Achievement and Knowledge) is an intensive, education-focused Alternative to Placement (ATP) program for youth involved in the juvenile justice system. The program combines educational enrichment, behavioral and therapeutic supports, and ongoing probation supervision to improve academic and behavioral outcomes and help youth remain safely in the community rather than enter residential placement.
